title: eating the same meal 90 days in a row

segments.text: I posted a video online about how I'm eating the same thing for 90 days straight and everyone online is asking me what I eat daily. So, let's go through it. I've been eating the same thing to track what happens in my menstrual cycle. So, I rotate across the following meals every 4 days. This is designed by a 12-person medical team and they have the same calories, macros, and nutritional profile so that we keep things very consistent [music] across my menstrual cycle. Meal number one is the longevity smoothie bowl. This is something I have every single day and it is absolutely delicious. Second is the Vietnamese-inspired stir-fry. Now, this is not cooked in a traditional stir-fry method because we're trying to keep the

oil temperature as low as possible to not create AGEs, advanced glycation end products that are bad for the body. Now, for this protocol, I started eating meat. We wanted to get a baseline of what my diet would be like with meat before we tried non-meat options. Next is a sweet potato plus cabbage curry with grass-fed beef. The next is the Mediterranean roasted bowl with beef, which I look forward to every time I have it. Okay, the last one is whitefish [music] plus vegetable stir-fry bowl. I'm keeping everything as consistent as possible so we can actually see what changes about my cycle. I'm also doing things like a continuous blood glucose management and [music] also tracking how

my metabolism changes throughout the cycle. So, what do you guys think? Would you eat these meals and which one do you think that looks [music] the best? If you're interested in finding out what happens in my results, follow along cuz we'll be sharing everything with you.
